datasheet_identity.title: BZT52C2V0 THRU BZT52C75 SOD-123 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes

extraction_notes: Fig. 1 curve identified as the BZT52C2V4 trace by its labelled '2.4' marker and by crossing 2.43 V at the specified IZT = 5 mA (nominal VZ = 2.4 V). Digitized from a 400 dpi raster by continuous trace; estimated read error about +/-0.02 V.
Trace slope near IZT is about 87 ohm, consistent with the ZZT maximum of 100 ohm at IZT = 5 mA.

Table values without a schema slot, preserved here: ZZT = 100 ohm max at IZT = 5 mA; ZZK = 600 ohm max at IZK = 1.0 mA; IZM (admissible zener current) = 5 mA; typical temperature coefficient -3.5 to 0 mV/degC at IZTC (p. 2).
Fig. 3 (capacitance) and Fig. 4 (leakage) on p. 3 are family-level plots versus nominal zener voltage, not part-specific characteristics; they were not digitized for this part.
In forward_voltage_points the current entry is the exact specified test condition (source_kind 'typical'); the voltage entry is a maximum rating.
Manufacturer footer full name: Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd (www.ichjc.com).
Additional ratings on p. 1: PD = 350 mW, RthJA = 357 degC/W. Fig. 1's overlaid power-limit locus is drawn for PD = 500 mW, not this part's 350 mW rating.
